q1: SELECT NAME FROM SALESPERSON AS S WHERE 0 = ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ORDERS AS O JOIN COMPANY AS C ON O.COM_ID = C.COM_ID WHERE O.SALES_ID = S.SALES_ID AND C.NAME = 'RED' )
q2: WITH T AS( SELECT ORDER_ID, C.COM_ID, SALES_ID, NAME FROM COMPANY C INNER JOIN ORDERS O ON C.COM_ID=O.COM_ID) , T2 AS ( SELECT S.NAME FROM SALESPERSON S LEFT JOIN T ON S.SALES_ID=T.SALES_ID WHERE T.NAME='RED') SELECT NAME FROM SALESPERSON WHERE NAME NOT IN (SELECT NAME FROM T2)
